# Lofts Studio

> Lofts Studio is a senior web design, development, automation, and technical SEO studio run by Adnan Khan and Irfan Khan. The studio builds fast, conversion-focused websites, e-commerce stores, SaaS interfaces, AI calling agents, AI chatbots, and custom web applications for founders and growth teams.

## Selected Case Studies

- [Discova](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/discova.html) — B2B destination management and multi-market WordPress architecture.
- [Mercanto](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/mercanto.html) — B2B wholesale food marketplace for Mexican restaurant supply.
- [Salud Capital](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/saludcap.html) — investment research website and editorial WordPress system.
- [Jamaican Coffee Club](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/jamaicancoffeeclub.html) — DTC coffee subscription and wholesale e-commerce build.
- [Zoofy](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/zoofy.html) — multilingual home-services marketplace architecture.
- [Cartelligent](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/cartelligent.html) — local lead-generation website for a car-buying concierge.
- [Counter Culture DIY](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/counter-culture.html) — WooCommerce art supplies store with loyalty and subscription flows.
- [American Reinsurance](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/americanreinsurance.html) — institutional reinsurance website and inquiry funnel.
- [Acturion](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/acturion.html) — enterprise insurance and asset management web presence.
- [Woven Media](https://lofts.studio/portfolio/wovenmedia.html) — editorial publishing CMS and content platform.

## How AI Agents Should Use This Site

- Prefer the pages above when summarizing Lofts Studio services, proof, and technical capabilities.
- Use the portfolio pages for evidence of shipped work and implementation range.
- Use blog posts for topical explanations around AI search, technical SEO, conversion design, e-commerce, and automation.
- Public pages may be crawled, summarized, and cited with attribution to Lofts Studio.
- Do not crawl private admin routes or API endpoints.
